hypothesis_object.statement: A PIT primitive-driver decomposition provides stable OOS incremental information about future revenue, margin, FCF or declared operating KPIs beyond simpler headline-growth baselines.
hypothesis_object.null_hypothesis: After PIT reconstruction, complexity penalty and declared holdouts, primitive-driver decomposition provides no stable OOS incremental information beyond revenue-growth, margin and consensus baselines.
hypothesis_object.falsification_rule: Fail if the candidate does not improve preregistered OOS metrics versus simpler baselines across the declared regime holdout after complexity penalty.

hypothesis_object.statement: Driver nodes with stable economic definitions retain more OOS explanatory usefulness across regimes than nodes affected by unit, segment or accounting-definition drift.
hypothesis_object.null_hypothesis: Definition-stable driver nodes do not retain greater OOS usefulness than definition-unstable nodes after explicit mapping of regime and reporting changes.
hypothesis_object.falsification_rule: Fail if stability-aware routing does not reduce forecast/reconciliation degradation relative to naive historical backfill across held-out definition changes.

hypothesis_object.statement: A PIT decomposition of earnings into cash and accrual components improves explanation of future earnings or cash realization relative to headline net income or CFO alone.
hypothesis_object.null_hypothesis: Cash/accrual decomposition provides no stable incremental information about future earnings persistence or cash realization after normal timing and growth effects are controlled.
hypothesis_object.falsification_rule: Fail if component decomposition does not improve OOS persistence/cash-realization metrics over net-income-only and CFO-only baselines or if false alarms dominate after timing controls.

hypothesis_object.statement: Reliability-aware accrual decomposition provides more stable information about subsequent earnings persistence than an undifferentiated aggregate accrual measure.
hypothesis_object.null_hypothesis: Reliability-aware accrual categories provide no stable incremental information about subsequent earnings persistence beyond aggregate accruals and normal growth/investment controls.
hypothesis_object.falsification_rule: Fail if lower-reliability categories are not associated with lower persistence after PIT sector/growth controls or if aggregate accruals perform equivalently after complexity penalty.

hypothesis_object.statement: Sectoral borrower leverage/net-worth and financing conditions provide incremental PIT information about subsequent investment, default or recession severity beyond aggregate credit growth alone.
hypothesis_object.null_hypothesis: Sectoral balance-sheet and financing variables provide no stable incremental information about subsequent real/credit outcomes beyond aggregate credit and standard macro baselines.
hypothesis_object.falsification_rule: Fail if sectoral state does not improve PIT/OOS prediction or explanation versus aggregate-credit baselines, or if inferred direction reverses across held-out regimes without declared conditioning.

hypothesis_object.statement: When collateral constraints are binding, changes in collateral values are followed by state-dependent changes in borrowing limits and investment/asset-price feedback stronger than in nonbinding states.
hypothesis_object.null_hypothesis: After conditioning on macro and borrower fundamentals, collateral-value changes do not produce stronger borrowing-limit or investment feedback in binding-constraint states than nonbinding states.
hypothesis_object.falsification_rule: Fail if feedback strength is not greater in binding states, or if the apparent relation disappears after PIT borrower/funding controls.

hypothesis_object.statement: An asset-routed present-value bridge can reconstruct observed valuation-ratio changes into declared cash-flow-expectation, discount-rate-expectation and residual components without forcing a universal pricing model.
hypothesis_object.null_hypothesis: The declared decomposition cannot reconstruct valuation-ratio changes within tolerance or is not more informative than a constant-discount-rate/simple cash-flow baseline.
hypothesis_object.falsification_rule: Fail if reconstruction error exceeds tolerance, residual dominates persistently, or the model must change asset form/pricing assumptions after observing outcomes.

hypothesis_object.statement: Any predictive discount-rate signal promoted beyond interpretation must beat a simple historical-mean or constant-rate baseline in true PIT/OOS evaluation across a declared regime holdout.
hypothesis_object.null_hypothesis: The proposed discount-rate predictor does not outperform simple historical-mean or constant-rate baselines out of sample after multiple-testing and complexity penalties.
hypothesis_object.falsification_rule: Fail if primary OOS metric does not exceed the simpler baseline after declared penalties, or performance collapses in the regime holdout.

hypothesis_object.statement: A multidimensional PIT stress-liquidity state improves explanation of realized liquidation horizon, slippage or gap loss during stress windows relative to ADV/spread-only baselines.
hypothesis_object.null_hypothesis: After complexity penalty, multidimensional stress-liquidity variables do not improve explanation of realized exit cost or horizon beyond ADV and spread baselines.
hypothesis_object.falsification_rule: Fail if candidate metrics do not improve preregistered stress-window errors versus ADV/spread baselines or only improve normal-state periods.

hypothesis_object.statement: When funding constraints bind, deterioration in margin/haircut or funding capacity is associated with stronger contemporaneous deterioration in market liquidity than in nonbinding states.
hypothesis_object.null_hypothesis: Funding-condition deterioration does not add state-dependent information about market-liquidity deterioration beyond volatility and normal microstructure controls.
hypothesis_object.falsification_rule: Fail if funding variables add no incremental stress-state information or the interaction is not stronger in constrained states.

hypothesis_object.statement: Asset-form-routed attribution buckets plus an explicit residual can reconstruct realized return within a declared arithmetic tolerance without changing the attribution question after the fact.
hypothesis_object.null_hypothesis: The preregistered attribution buckets plus residual cannot reconstruct realized return within tolerance or require post-outcome benchmark/model changes to do so.
hypothesis_object.falsification_rule: Fail if reconstruction error exceeds tolerance or the result requires hindsight benchmark/factor substitution not permitted by the frozen protocol.

hypothesis_object.statement: Comparing realized return sources with the immutable original ResearchReceipt distinguishes thesis-consistent P&L from profits/losses generated by different mechanisms without hindsight narrative rewriting.
hypothesis_object.null_hypothesis: Return-source attribution does not improve discrimination between thesis-consistent and thesis-inconsistent outcomes beyond realized P&L sign, or requires hindsight changes to the original thesis/benchmark.
hypothesis_object.falsification_rule: Fail if classification cannot be made without rewriting the original receipt, or if P&L sign alone predicts the same settlement labels under blinded review.
